definition: A collection of well-defined objects or elements. Think of it like a basket of fruits from Chisokone market.
A set with no elements. Denoted by {} or ∅. Like a wallet when it's month-end but the salary hasn't dropped!
The set of elements that are common to two or more sets. Symbolized by ∩. Like items sold at both a kantemba and a big shop.
The set containing all elements of all sets being considered. Symbolized by ∪. Bringing all your small baskets into one big heap.
A whole number that can be positive, negative, or zero. Negative integers are like having a debt (kaloba) at the local shop.
A mathematical statement that asserts the equality of two expressions. It's like a balancing scale at Soweto Market; both sides must be equal.
A symbol (usually a letter like x) used to represent a number that can change. Like the price of fuel—today it is this, tomorrow it is that!
A comparison of two quantities by division. Like mixing juice: 1 cup of concentrate to 4 cups of water.
